0.reason: a receipt figure mismatch in the manifest; the gate log records the same growth rate of 2 stat calls per other run at base, so the conclusion stands

findings.text: non-blocking: the base implement-landing counts 2464 and 2824, repeated at manifest.md line 18, do not appear in the cited gate-head.log, which records 3515 and 3875; the growth rate is identical at 2 stat per other run so the conclusion stands, but a reader cannot reconcile the quoted figure with the log it cites, so correct both to the log's own numbers.

non-blocking: the section's done-when names a negative control that reintroduces the rollout lookup with no run_id into the promotion case so its 200-run count exceeds its 20-run count; this test measures that lookup directly at both populations outside the verb, so the promotion case itself is never shown to rise on that regression, and the base-revision arm covers a different walk.

item_verdicts.call_sites: Verified five production call sites of the two changed functions, the promotion path and the release path among them, and no test file is counted.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit from af2b3d53; 7eedfc77e9 adds the guard module and fragment, 9bf25a6ca2 adds _index_record_written_document and its two call points in reckon/ledger.py, a69fb27ec1 updates the fragment figures, 698 insertions and no deletions, all inside the granted paths.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done-when names three cases, 20 and 200 populations, equal stat/scandir/listdir/glob counts and a warm second invocation under two minutes; gate.log records 4 passed in 65.79s EXIT=0 at 9bf25a6ca2 and gate-head.log records the pre-change revision failing by exactly 2 stat per other run, but the done-when's named rollout-lookup control was substituted at tests/test_a_crew_verb_costs_the_same_at_any_population.py:522 rather than reinstated in the promotion case.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is a crew verb whose cost does not grow with the run population; tests/test_a_crew_verb_costs_the_same_at_any_population.py:497 drives the three named verbs and reckon/ledger.py:1247 publishes the written document so the following read reuses its index.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it records commits 7eedfc77e9, 9bf25a6ca2 and a69fb27ec1, gate.log 4 passed EXIT=0, the ledger suite 14 passed EXIT=0, ruff clean and a two-arm importer population of 38 versus 39 failures, but its negative_control_note quotes an implement-landing base count of 2464 to 2824 that gate-head.log records as 3515 to 3875.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The dispatch fenced the node to the new test, the fragment and the figure directory; the coordinator's resume advice grants reckon/ledger.py and git diff af2b3d53..a69fb27e touches only reckon/ledger.py, the test and the fragment.

justifications.durability: The guard fails at the pre-change revisions (gate-head.log, gate-fix.log) and passes at 9bf25a6ca2 with an unchanged test module, so removing reckon/ledger.py:1247 reddens it.
justifications.evidence: gate.log ends 4 passed in 65.79s and EXIT=0 at 9bf25a6ca2 and gate-head.log shows the pre-change failure, but the fragment line 35 and manifest line 18 base figures do not reconcile with gate-head.log and the done-when's named control was substituted.
justifications.fit: reckon/ledger.py:1247 follows the module's private-helper and sqlite idioms established at reckon/ledger.py:1756, and no symbol carries a plan label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1247 publishes the one document each of write_run_file and append_run touches, and arm-figures.log shows every case identical at 20 and 200.
justifications.reuse: A search over reckon/ for a single-document index publisher found _index_append (run_store, a different store) and _indexed_data.update (the index's full-load path), and the addition extends that same index in place rather than forking a second, though it restates a few lines of the INSERT update performs at reckon/ledger.py:1909.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat af2b3d53..a69fb27e changes only reckon/ledger.py, the new test and the fragment, all inside the granted paths.
